title: Documentation restructuring, README rewrite, handoff slimming, and executable-guard debt classification

docs_restructured.readme: Rewritten as a public open-source-style project entry point.
docs_restructured.current_handoff: Slimmed to current operational state, route, non-goals, validation seeds, and links.
docs_restructured.project_roadmap: Active roadmap and governance sections moved near the top; historical phase log preserved as archive/reference in the same file.
docs_restructured.test_workflow: Scope-based validation and current SourceConcept entry points clarified near the top.

docs/archive_or_phase_history.note: No separate archive file was created; historical traceability remains in project-roadmap under an archive heading.

readme_rewrite.summary: README now covers project purpose, key features, current status, architecture, quick start, safety/privacy model, documentation map, development focus, and upstream attribution without becoming a phase changelog.

handoff_slimming.summary: Long historical accepted-state paragraphs were removed from current-handoff and replaced with current accepted SC1/SC2 state, route, non-goals, validation seeds, governance reminders, and links.

roadmap_restructure.summary: Current active roadmap, near-term route, and governance standards now appear near the top. Historical details remain in the same file under Phase Archive / Historical Traceability to minimize churn.

test_workflow_restructure.summary: Docs-only validation, SC1/SC2/SCV1 entry points, and DOC1 documentation-state guard are clarified near the top while long test inventory remains reference material.

evidence: SC2 redaction tests for detail/media/search/promotion payloads

guard_debt_classification.why_not_now: SC2 has focused fixture coverage, but broad real-DB alias symmetry requires SCV1 current-data inventory and sampling.
guard_debt_classification.future_guard_shape: Read-only search-symmetry runner or focused tests over real current SourceConcept aliases, including cross-language variants and hidden-status exclusions.

guard_debt_classification.why_not_now: DOC1-R1 touches docs/tests only, and current SC2 read routes do not depend on provider/LLM/source-enrichment adapters.
guard_debt_classification.future_phase: Any future SourceConcept read/write phase that introduces provider-adjacent dependencies
guard_debt_classification.future_guard_shape: Monkeypatch provider/LLM/source-enrichment adapters to assert no calls, or add an explicit dependency allowlist for read routes.

guard_debt_classification.why_not_now: DOC1-R1 is documentation restructuring and cannot run broad current-data validation.
guard_debt_classification.future_guard_shape: Read-only coverage inventory and redacted validation runner covering media/source signal/SourceConcept coverage, alias gaps, needs_review clusters, redaction, and search symmetry.

guard_debt_classification.why_not_now: DOC1-R1 does not implement editing, management, promotion, or truth writes.
guard_debt_classification.future_phase: SC3 or explicit Entity bridge phase
guard_debt_classification.future_guard_shape: Tests and write guards for preview-only flows, manual confirmation, audit trail, rollback/supersede, and no media_tags/entity truth pollution.

guard_debt_classification.why_not_now: DOC1-R1 performs no provider, gallery-dl, LLM, source-enrichment, or broad run work.
guard_debt_classification.future_phase: Provider/source/LLM run phase before any execution
guard_debt_classification.future_guard_shape: Provider policy tests, privacy eligibility gates, budget/rate-limit/cache/audit assertions, and redacted public/private artifact checks.

guard_debt_classification.why_not_now: DOC1-R1 is not a broad import or full-library execution phase.
guard_debt_classification.future_phase: Phase 3.9 or equivalent run-ledger prerequisite phase
guard_debt_classification.future_guard_shape: Production ingestion/source item ledger with per-item final state, failure reason, retry/defer state, imported media ID, and public/private artifact separation.

guard_debt_classification.why_not_now: This is process/repository governance; DOC1-R1 cannot enforce GitHub admin rules from repo docs.
guard_debt_classification.future_guard_shape: GitHub branch protection or rulesets requiring PR-based merge and blocking direct pushes to main.

executable_guards_added.scope: Documentation-state and summary JSON guard only; no DB/server/runtime/UI/provider/LLM dependency.
